name: move_selected_object_to_position_at_twice_speed

stack.evidence: func_001D2D28 consumes speed, X, Y, and Z, snapshots the selected object's current position, stores the target coordinates and twice the per-update step distance in Script movement state, and decrements Script stackTop by four

notes: The handler sets the same Script update flag 0x40 consumed by func_001D2AF0 as command 157 move_selected_object_to_position_at_speed, but doubles the supplied speed before storing it. Representative al09.ard calls pass speed 7 and variable-derived coordinates.
